summary: Master AI and Machine Learning in Financial Supervision. Learn SupTech strategies, NLP, and anomaly detection to enhance regulatory oversight. Enroll today.
lede: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Financial Supervision helps professionals process large datasets, uncover hidden risk patterns, and move from reactive oversight toward proactive supervision. This ten-day training develops practical capabilities in automated data ingestion, predictive risk modelling, algorithmic transparency, and scalable supervisory analysis. You will apply supervised learning to credit risk, unsupervised learning to anomaly detection in anti-money laundering workflows, and Natural Language Processing to regulatory filings. The course also covers supervisory dashboards, model risk management audits, explainable AI, and governance frameworks, helping you evaluate models while building practical internal SupTech capabilities.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals tasked with maintaining financial stability and market integrity in an increasingly automated global economy.
modules: SupTech Foundations and the Regulatory Landscape
Algorithmic Trading and Market Conduct Oversight
Generative AI and the Future of Supervision
Cybersecurity and Data Privacy in SupTech
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial regulatory principles and basic data analysis concepts. Familiarity with Excel is required; prior exposure to Python or R is beneficial but not mandatory as technical basics will be covered.
